name: Subdomain Enumeration
content:
Enumerate all subdomains of {domain}.

Methods to use :
1. DNS brute force : `subfinder -d {domain} -all`
2. Certificate transparency : `crt.sh, certspotter`
3. DNS zone transfer : `dig axfr {domain} @ns`
4. Permutations : `dnsgen, altdns`
5. Archives and search engines

For each discovered subdomain :
- Resolve its IP address
- Check whether it is active (httpx)
- Identify the service

Suggested commands :
```bash
subfinder -d {domain} -all -o subs.txt
cat subs.txt | httpx -silent -title -status-code -tech-detect
```
